messages:
mia_cs: Quick roundup from three handoffs — putting raw quotes + asks here so product can triage. Short bullets below.

- Atlas Retail (SMB): wants a simple way to 'snooze' test routes so billing doesn't show them in month-end exports. Quote: "Our ledger team spends an hour cleaning test noise every month. A snooze would save us time."
- NovaBank (Pilot): says embeddings search sometimes returns outdated docs after upserts; they asked for an event/webhook so they stop polling.
- PixelPlay (PLG): confused by Dedicated opt-in UX; they expected to see an estimate if they switched.

Docs: drive/roundup/2024-03-quick-handoff.csv (shared). Can product help split into quick-fix vs infra investigation vs roadmap?

owen_pm: Thanks Mia. Quick asks: NovaBank webhook  what payload shape do they want? Atlas snooze sounds like a quick UX. PixelPlay Dedicated estimate modal looks like small copy + calc.

mia_cs: NovaBank pasted this desired webhook body in the notes: 
```
POST https://hooks.novabank.io/upsert-ready
{
  "customer_id": "nb-77",
  "route": "eu-central-1",
  "job_id": "job-999",
  "status": "completed",
  "updated": 128,
  "completed_at": "2024-06-18T12:34:56Z"
}
```
They said: "if we got this we would stop polling every 10s and avoid stale UI for our traders."

devon_eng: Webhook generator doable. We'll need to design retries & backoff, plus a way for customers to subscribe per-route. Also will investigate why upserts appear stale  might be indexer lag or caching. Need a minimal repro from NovaBank with timestamps.

sara_fin: On Atlas billing: they want snooze to exclude specific routes from exports (not delete usage). That maps to finance wanting an export filter. If we can add a CSV toggle that excludes snoozed routes, it's a big win.

own_pm: Proposed triage lanes: 
- Quick fix (1 sprint): snooze/mute test routes toggle in billing export + Dedicated opt-in estimate modal copy.
- Infra investigate (sprint): webhook delivery + indexer consistency probe + add metrics (upsert->search-latency).
- Roadmap (Q3): per-route billing grouping & downloadable ledger with tags + subscription manager for webhooks.

mia_cs: I'll create three tickets and paste links. Also cc'ing finance on export format so we can pick fields for CSV.

issuebot: /create_issue quick "billing-snooze-export" created by mia_cs. Link: https://gh/repo/issues/9999

mia_cs: created infra ticket for webhook & attached NovaBank sample payload + raw logs. Link: https://gh/repo/issues/10000

devon_eng: I'll attempt a repro with the payload today. If I can reproduce, will attach a minimal repro & tag infra. ETA EOD. If not, we'll ask NovaBank for exact timestamps and enable debug logs.

own_pm: Sara, can finance confirm required CSV columns? For now assume: date, route_id, route_name, usage_tokens, unit_price, total.

sara_fin: Confirming those columns. Also add a billing_tag column to support snooze reasons.

own_pm: Great. Mia, can you draft a 2-line enablement snippet for CSMs to explain snooze behavior and Dedicated estimate edge cases? Drop it here and we'll add to the enablement doc.

mia_cs: Draft: "If a customer snoozes a route, it will be excluded from exports but usage is still recorded in system; to un-snooze open Billing > Routes." Will post final in Confluence after design mock.

devon_eng: Repro steps posted: minimal upsert call + immediate search. If we still see old results I'll open an infra bug.

own_pm: Thanks everybody. If NovaBank looks like renewal-risk we'll label accordingly. Keep updates here. :mag:
